hero.headline:
You know English.
Now speak it with confidence.
hero.sub: Takalam helps adults who understand English but freeze when it's time to speak. Take the free test and get a real diagnosis, not a sales pitch.
doors.heading: Two doors. The same place on the other side: you, speaking freely.
speak.label: Takalam Speak
speak.tag: For when your English is good, but speaking still scares you.
speak.body: Your grammar is solid. Your vocabulary is there. You can handle the tenses. But in a real conversation you hesitate, you fill the silence with ums, you freeze in meetings, and speaking with others stresses you out. Speak fixes exactly this. In small groups of ten, you practice real scenarios through guided breakout discussion until speaking becomes natural instead of frightening.
speak.fact2: 2 live sessions a week, 90 minutes each
speak.fact3: Breakout pairs and trios, so everyone speaks
private.label: Takalam Private
private.tag: For when you have a specific goal and need a plan built around you.
private.body: Some goals need a program shaped entirely around one person. Exam preparation like IELTS, TOEFL, or the Duolingo English Test. Interview preparation. Presentations. A personal target with a deadline. Private is one to one coaching focused only on you, your level, and what you need to achieve.
private.fact1: One to one, 50 minutes, fully online
private.fact2: You book your own slot, flexible scheduling
how.heading: Three steps to speaking.
step1.p: Ten minutes, three spoken answers, a real diagnosis of where you are.
step2.p: Your band, your own words, and the one thing to fix next.
step3.p: Show up, practice for real, and watch the fear shrink.
faq.heading: Things people ask us.
faq.sub: Still wondering about something? Take the free test, or message us on WhatsApp.
faq: How do I know if Speak or Private is right for me?
Take the free test. It gives you a real diagnosis and, if you're a fit, one clear recommendation between the two, based on your actual level and goal.
Are the classes online or in person?
Everything is fully online, so you can join from home, the office, or anywhere with a decent connection. No commute, no traffic, just you and the conversation.
What level of English do I need to start?
You should already understand English and read and write it at an intermediate level or above. Takalam is for people who know the language but struggle to speak it freely, not for absolute beginners.
What happens after I take the free test?
You get a results page immediately: your level, your own words transcribed, and one honest recommendation. No call, no chat needed unless you want one.
How big are the Speak groups?
Ten students target per group. Sessions run in breakout pairs and trios, so you speak for real every session instead of listening at the back.
What can Private coaching help with?
Exam preparation for IELTS, TOEFL, or the Duolingo English Test. Interview preparation. Presentations. Or any personal target with a deadline. The whole program is built around you.
How many sessions will I need for Private?
It depends entirely on your goal and your starting point. You can book a single session or a pack of 3, 5, or 10, and stay in control of the pace.
What if I miss a session?
For Private, reschedule free up to 24 hours before. For Speak, sessions follow the group and are not made up individually, which is exactly why the price is low.
Yes, any time, in two clicks. And if you've attended two sessions or fewer, you get a full refund within 14 days.
closing.heading: Not sure which one fits?
closing.body: Take the free ten-minute test. It gives you a real diagnosis either way, and if you're a fit for Takalam it tells you exactly which path and why.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.p_what: When you take the free English level test, we record your spoken answers, transcribe them automatically, and generate a written assessment of your English level from that transcript and recording.
privacy.p_why: To assess your spoken English and recommend the right course. Nothing else.
privacy.p_retention: Recordings and transcripts are kept for 12 months from the date of the test, then deleted automatically. If you are under 18, this is reduced to 6 months, and a parent or guardian must consent before the test is taken.
privacy.p_who: Your test results and recordings are visible only to Takalam's teacher, for the purpose of your assessment and coaching. They are never sold, shared with advertisers, or used in marketing without your separate, explicit consent.
privacy.p_rights_html: You can ask for a copy of your data or ask us to delete it at any time by messaging Takalam on WhatsApp or emailing Takalamenglishcenter@gmail.com. A fully self-serve download/delete option in your account is planned but not live yet.
privacy.p_payments: If you enroll in a paid course, payment is processed by PayPal. We never see or store your card or bank details -- PayPal handles that directly.
